testId: testim-migrated/tests/admin/sales-rep/sales-rep-management.spec.ts > Admin - Sales Rep > Z10-TC-23083 sales rep details save without a generic error after a password reset

scenario.summary: Right after a password reset on a sales rep's Manage page, the admin saves without changes and then changes the phone number and saves and closes; no generic error is shown and the page closes.
steps: Precondition: open the sales rep's (@rep.userId) Manage page; Reset Password: Submit, Ok.
Change Phone Number (made up by the test).
stateChanges: The sales rep's password is reset (email to its @example.test address) and its phone number changed (deleted at teardown).
assertions: Save without changes shows no generic error message
Save and Close after the phone change shows no generic error message and the page closes
evidence: Story Z10-28590 (Stabilize Sales Rep Workflow), data-needs analysis work/stories/Z10-28590/analysis.md section 8 (group A remainder) and answers in sections 6 and 8.3.
FSD 'Manage an Existing Sales Rep': after a password reset the record saves with no changes, without a generic error on Save or Save and Close.
The password reset of the precondition is done in the test (Reset Password Submit, Ok) and checked by its notification.
Store MaxwellsHardware: the store the migrated suites run on (store A).
Admin session: the suite's saved admin session (admin.setup.ts), a credential, not a need.
